headline: Most AI apps fail in production (not in demos)
summary: AI applications often perform flawlessly in demos but struggle when deployed to production, crashing under real-world loads and diverse data.
details: Many AI applications perform flawlessly in controlled demonstration environments but struggle significantly when deployed to production. This discrepancy often arises when facing real-world user loads and diverse data inputs.

A key challenge is the difference between development and production data. Models trained on clean, curated datasets frequently encounter unexpected data quality issues, formats, or edge cases in live systems, leading to performance degradation.

Scalability and robust error handling are critical for production success. An AI system must be designed to manage concurrent users and gracefully recover from unforeseen issues, which is often overlooked in early development phases.

Effective monitoring and continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines are essential for maintaining AI app reliability. Without these, identifying and resolving production failures quickly becomes a major hurdle, impacting user trust.
caption:
AI apps shine in demos, but often crash under real-world load. Why do so many fail in production?

Many AI applications perform flawlessly in controlled demonstration environments but struggle significantly when deployed to production. This discrepancy often arises when facing real-world user loads and diverse data inputs.

A key challenge is the difference between development and production data. Models trained on clean, curated datasets frequently encounter unexpected data quality issues, formats, or edge cases in live systems, leading to performance degradation.

Scalability and robust error handling are critical for production success. An AI system must be designed to manage concurrent users and gracefully recover from unforeseen issues, which is often overlooked in early development phases.

Effective monitoring and continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines are essential for maintaining AI app reliability. Without these, identifying and resolving production failures quickly becomes a major hurdle, impacting user trust.
